title: Frontend alignment for inquiry submission/retrieval API compatibility

requirements.summary: Keep frontend inquiry submission compatible with backend actor methods and add a frontend query hook for retrieving stored inquiries.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend inquiry submission flows (Contact page and Catalogue request) successfully call actor.submitInquiry without runtime actor/method mismatch errors.
The backend exposes a query method that returns the stored inquiry records in a structured array type.
End-to-end: submitting an inquiry from the UI results in the inquiry being retrievable from the backend retrieval method.

file_operations.description: Extend the inquiry hooks to (1) keep submitInquiry invocation aligned with the backendInterface signature and (2) add a React Query hook that calls actor.getAllInquiries and caches results under the existing ['inquiries'] query key for retrieval/verification purposes.

Update inquiry submission error handling to display clear English error messages returned/thrown by the backend (when available), while preserving the existing required-field validation for name, country, email, category, and message.

Update catalogue request submission error handling to display clear English error messages returned/thrown by the backend (when available), while keeping the existing behavior that supplies required backend fields (category and a non-empty message fallback).
